description: For a brand domain, generates up to 24 lookalike names (letter omission, doubling and swapping, plus .co/.net/.org/.io swaps) and checks which ones have name servers in DNS right now. Registered-looking names are listed with their name servers. A lookalike with no name servers may still be registered without DNS, and this is not a trademark or phishing verdict. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_domain_typosquatting
title: Security Domain Typosquatting
